title: Igitangaza c'ikimenyamenya gicereje
intro: Uhura n’igishushanyo gipfutse inkuru y’ukuntu Imana yinjiramwo. Inkuru y’ugutunganirizwa kw’igitangaza n’ukwigwanira ata majambo kuvuga gusubiramwo mu gihe. Woba ushobora guhishura abashikiwe n’ico kigeragezo kidasanzwe?
clues: Naronse ubutumwa buva ku Mana bwansize ntangaye .
Abantu banje barakekeranya ubusuku bwanje igihe nagaruka mfise umwana .
Nategetswe kwisonzesha kugira ngo ntavuge igihe kanaka .
Isôko ry’amazi n’amadate vyaramfashije mu gihe c’ikigeragezo canje .
Umukama wanje yatumye igiti kinyiganyiga ku gitangaza kugira ngo ampeho .
Umumarayika arambonekera afise ishusho y'umuntu atunganye .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Ukutagira icaha kwanje kwagaragajwe igihe umuhungu wanje w’uruyoya yavuga .
outcome.answer: Ukutagira icaha kwanje kwagaragajwe igihe umuhungu wanje w’uruyoya yavuga .

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
